comment: The sibling checkouts apps/camera/oh compiles against. Checked by pins.py, which build.sh runs. The Makepad host has its own chain in OctoSense-mobile's native-runtime.lock.json and does not read this file.

Octoscript-OH.note: One commit ahead of master: the ArkUI raw touch stream and the rotate attribute the camera needs. Move this to master once that lands.

makepad.note: Only platform/script is used here, pulled in by the Octoscript VM. This revision is the merge of the Android capture work and its script crate is byte-identical to the feat/android-camera-capture tip.
